journal: Elsevier journals with the current Guide for Authors template (shared rules)
snapshot_note: Rules that three Elsevier Guides for Authors state word for word (Gene; Computers in Biology and Medicine; International Journal of Biological Macromolecules). Whether highlights or a graphical abstract are required, the reference style (some journals take any consistent style at submission), and article types differ by journal: SubmitReady reads those from the journal's own guide on every run.

sources.name: Computers in Biology and Medicine: Guide for authors
International Journal of Biological Macromolecules: Guide for authors

csl_style.note: Depends on the journal. Several accept any consistent style at submission; others give a numbered style in square brackets.

requirements.rule: Abstract of at most 250 words, able to stand alone
requirements.quote: You are required to provide a concise and factual abstract that does not exceed 250 words.
You are required to provide 1 to 7 keywords for indexing purposes.

requirements.rule: Highlights: 3 to 5 bullet points of at most 85 characters each, in a separate editable file with 'highlights' in the file name
requirements.quote: Highlights should consist of 3 to 5 bullet points, each a maximum of 85 characters, including spaces.

requirements.rule: Word files in a single-column layout (.docx); LaTeX as .tex
requirements.quote: Format Word files in a single-column layout.

requirements.rule: Title page with the corresponding author's email, which is published
requirements.quote: The email address of the corresponding author must be included on the title page and will be published in the article.

requirements.rule: Funding sources, or the sentence that the research had no specific grant
requirements.quote: If no funding has been provided for the research, please include the following sentence:

requirements.rule: Declaration of competing interests (uploaded as a Word file from the declarations tool)
requirements.quote: The resulting Word document containing your declaration should be uploaded at the "attach/upload files" step in the submission process.

requirements.rule: A section 'Declaration of generative AI and AI-assisted technologies in the manuscript preparation process' before the references, when such tools were used (grammar and spelling checkers excluded)
requirements.quote: The statement will appear in the published work and should be placed in a new section before the reference list.
Corresponding authors are required to acknowledge co-author contributions using CRediT (Contributor Roles Taxonomy) roles:

requirements.rule: Acknowledgments in their own section directly before the reference list, nowhere else
requirements.quote: Acknowledgments should be placed in a separate section that appears directly before the reference list.

requirements.rule: Tables are editable text, cited and numbered in order, with captions
requirements.quote: Tables must be submitted as editable text, not as images.

requirements.rule: Figures are separate files named like Figure_1 (LaTeX may embed them)
requirements.quote: Figures, images, diagrams, and other graphical media (artwork) must be supplied as separate files along with the manuscript

requirements.rule: Photographs TIFF, JPG or PNG at 300 dpi or more; bitmapped line drawings at 1000 dpi
Images made with generative AI say so in each caption
requirements.quote: If you used generative AI tools to create images in your manuscript, disclose this in each image caption as well as in the general generative AI disclosure statement.

requirements.rule: Web references give the full URL and the date last accessed
requirements.quote: When listing web references, as a minimum you should provide the full URL and the date when the reference was last accessed.

requirements.rule: Every supplementary file is cited in the text and has a caption
requirements.quote: Cite all supplementary files in the manuscript text.

requirements.rule: No reference-manager field codes in the submitted file (convert the upload copy to plain text)
requirements.quote: We advise you to remove all field codes before submitting your manuscript

requirements.rule: Read on the journal's own guide: whether highlights and a graphical abstract are required, the reference style (or format-free references), and article types with their limits
